# TOPFLOWNG FULL AUTONOMOUS COMPLETION REPORT

**MODE**: FULL AUTONOMOUS (no confirmation checks)
**Repository**: `Itsjaywealth/topflowng`
**Branch**: `main` (GitHub → Railway auto-deploy)
**Environment**: Production `https://topflowng.com` + `https://www.topflowng.com` (Cloudflare-fronted)
**Date**: 2026-08-18
**Report generated by**: `opencode` (FULL AUTONOMOUS mode)

## 1. Executive Summary

TopFlowNG was rebuilt end to end and shipped to production in fully autonomous mode. The product now runs on a single world-class design system (Deep Teal) across the public landing, auth, customer app, and admin console, with complete light/dark themes and real provider logos. The customer catalogue was aligned with the live provider: 9mobile was rebranded to T2 (official logo + `#FF5C05` accent), and electricity coverage grew from 6 to all 12 verified DISCOs. A critical production defect — electricity/cable/recharge-pin purchases sending an empty phone to VTPass — was fixed at the route layer with a payload-audit test suite. Every gate is green: syntax 51/51, frontend/static 78/78, backend 216/216, browser 72/72, GitHub Actions green on all pushed commits, and production serves the new build with all assets returning 200. No customer-facing `9mobile` string remains; internal contract keys are intentionally preserved.

## 3. What Changed

### A. Design
- **Semantic token layer**: `--bg/--surface/--surface-raised/--surface-muted`, `--text-primary/-secondary/-muted`, `--border-subtle/-strong`, `--brand/-hover/-soft/-ink`, semantic `--success/--warning/--danger/--info`, and a focus-ring token — each independently designed for light and dark themes (dark bg `#0C1828`, surfaces `#132038`/`#182A45`; light `#F4F6F9`/`#FFFFFF`).
- **Fixed dark-theme selector bug**: CSS used `[data-theme="dark"]` while JS toggles the `.dark` class — dark mode had never applied. Now `html.dark` selectors.
- **Fixed dead CSS vars**: the additive shell styles referenced undefined vars (`--mist`, `--green-strong`, `--white`, `--red`, `--blue`, `--dur`, `--ease`, …) leaving the quickpay launcher, promo banners, and PIN prompt unstyled; all re-pointed at the semantic tokens.
- **Landing rebuild**: editorial fintech layout — frosted sticky nav, trust strip, hero with a live wallet-ledger preview, service cards with real provider logos, pricing cards, promo engine, CTA, footer.
- **App shell**: refined header/balance panel, bottom nav (now 5 items incl. Wallet), and a **functional desktop sidebar** — the sidebar CSS existed but no items were ever rendered, so desktop users had no navigation; now Home/Wallet/Services/History/Account.
- **Surfaces elevated**: auth card, service slide-in panels, network/provider chips, amount presets, plan lists, history filters, transaction rows, receipt overlay, modals, account screens, and the admin console (switched from legacy green to the Deep Teal master brand) all use the new tokens with premium radii and consistent type scale (Plus Jakarta Sans display + Inter body).
- **Font load deduplicated** (Inter was loaded twice).

### B. Functionality
- **New Wallet screen**: balance hero with Fund/Transactions actions, credits vs spend stats, and a wallet activity feed (wired into tab navigation).
- **Electricity phone-defect fix**: the JWT payload only carries `{ id, email }`, so cable/electricity/recharge-pin purchases sent an empty phone → VTPass `011 "phone is empty"` (reproduced live: failed order `2026081818237a6d7b11f771`, no debit). Routes now resolve the account holder's phone from the DB (`users.phone` is NOT NULL) and normalize to the `0XXXXXXXXXX` form VTPass accepts; applied to the interactive routes and the scheduled-purchase sweeper.
- **Payload audit**: `normalizeNigerianPhone` (`+234`/`234` → `0XXXXXXXXXX`, strips separators, fails closed) plus a test suite asserting no required provider field is empty/null/undefined/NaN and that unmapped products fail closed.
- **Desktop navigation** works for the first time (see A).

### C. Data / Catalogue
- **T2 (formerly 9mobile)**: official T2 logo added (`t2.png`, favicon-derived, verified 2026-08-18), `#FF5C05` accent, display name and all marketing/customer strings updated. Internal `9MOBILE`/`9mobile` keys preserved for VTPass (`etisalat`, `etisalat-data`) and contract tests.
- **All 12 DISCOs** now offered and selectable with official logos (JED, KAEDCO, EEDC, BEDC, APLE, YEDC added to IKEDC/EKEDC/AEDC/PHEDC/KEDC/IBEDC). Every service ID re-verified live against the active provider: all 12 return Prepaid/Postpaid variations.
- **Enabled-but-unmapped = 0**: the canonical registry (`getProductRegistry`) is derived from the same provider maps used to build purchases; tests assert no enabled product lacks a service ID/variation. Disabled items (Recharge Cards, JAMB/NECO/NABTEB) are visibly disabled with reasons.
- `SOURCES.md` updated with the provenance of every new logo.

### D. Testing & CI
- Syntax 51/51 · frontend/static 78/78 · backend 216/216 · browser 72/72 (all green locally and in GitHub Actions on every push).
- New suites: `test/payload-audit.test.js` (15 tests) and DISCO/all-provider registry assertions; browser test now asserts all 12 DISCOs are selectable.
- One transient CI failure (`webhook` suite: "Server did not become healthy in time" — harness boot timeout) passed cleanly on rerun; no code change required.

### E. Production
- Auto-deployed to Railway from `main`; `https://topflowng.com/api/health` → 200.
- All assets verified live: t2.png, all 12 DISCO logos, 9mobile.webp, brand mark, manifest, robots/sitemap.
- Live browser QA at 320/375/768/1024/1440/1920 px: no horizontal overflow, landing + dark theme + auth all render; only console noise is Cloudflare's own injected analytics beacon (not loaded by our code).

## 1. Executive Summary

This pass closed the remaining genuine gaps identified in the previous audit: a **notification centre** (real event-driven, no demo data), **dual selectable palettes** (Teal + Emerald) independent of Light/Dark/System with no-flash persistence, a **transaction history upgrade** (category/status/date filters, date grouping, transaction detail, receipt share/download/print, and the `createTxnRow` undefined-bug fix), a **support/FAQ centre** with failed-transaction help, **electricity token durability** (persisted + recoverable by user and admin), an **admin operations center**, an **internal monitoring/alerting watchdog** (no paid services), and the **operations/scale/reliability documentation**.

All suites are green and CI is green on the pushed commit.

## 2. Commits Shipped (this pass)

| Commit | Description | Gates |
|---|---|---|
| `9361b69` | Notification centre, dual palettes, history detail/receipts, support, admin ops center, monitoring + ops docs | CI ✅ |

## 3. What Was Built (this pass)

### A. Notification Centre
- `migrations/009_notifications.sql`: notifications table + `(user_id, created_at DESC)` and unread indexes.
- `routes/notifications.js`: GET `/`, GET `/unread-count`, POST `/read/:id`, POST `/read-all`, DELETE `/:id` (auth + rate-limited, per-user scoped).
- Real event hooks: wallet credit (Paystack + referral), purchase success/pending/failed (services/vtpass.js), scheduled-purchase runs, and security (new sign-in). No fake demo notifications in production.
- Frontend: header bell + unread badge (polled), `#screen-notifications` with category filter chips, mark-all-read, deep-link to transaction, empty state, mobile/desktop, light/dark.

### B. Dual Selectable Palettes + Appearance
- **Palette A (TopFlow Teal, default)** and **Palette B (TopFlow Emerald)** as a brand layer independent of Light/Dark/System.
- Early synchronous head init (no flash) reads `topflowng-theme` + `topflowng-palette` before CSS paints.
- Account → Appearance panel: palette picker + theme picker (Light/Dark/System) with persistence and live system-preference listener; theme-color meta kept in sync.

### C. Transaction History
- Category filters (Wallet/Airtime/Data/Electricity/Cable/Education/Top-ups), status filters (All/Successful/Pending/Failed), date filters (Today/Week/Month), search.
- Date grouping (Today/Yesterday/Earlier this week/date), amount hierarchy, recipient extraction, time display.
- **Fixed the `createTxnRow` undefined-bug** (was called but never defined at the old line 3343).
- Transaction **detail overlay**: status, provider logo, amount, service, reference lines, durable electricity token, copy reference / share receipt / download–print / get help.
- Receipt generation as shareable text (Web Share API + clipboard fallback) and a printable window.

### D. Support Centre
- Support overlay with FAQ and a failed-transaction help block that pre-fills the transaction reference; reachable from Account and from any transaction detail.
- `support@topflowng.com` surface.

### E. Electricity Token Durability
- `recordVtuProviderResponse` now persists any vended `token`/`purchasedCode` into the order's provider response.
- User order endpoint (`/api/vtu/orders/:requestId`) exposes `electricityToken`; admin endpoint (`/api/admin/vtu-orders/:requestId`) exposes it for safe lookup.
- Detail overlay auto-fetches and shows the token with a copy button.
- Regression test: `electricity token is retrievable from the order after purchase`.

### F. Admin Operations Center + Monitoring
- `/api/admin/ops`: consolidated health (online, DB, provider, pending, stale pending, success rate, reconciliation, failed today, issues) — no secrets.
- Admin overview gains an Operations Center panel and a per-order "View token" action for electricity.
- `lib/alerting.js`: cooldown-gated structured ALERT conditions (vtpass_unreachable, stale_pending_orders, ledger_out_of_balance) with auto-clear on recovery. No paid monitoring.
- Ops watchdog runs every 60s.

### G. Documentation (docs/)
`ROLLBACK_RUNBOOK`, `DISASTER_RECOVERY`, `INCIDENT_RESPONSE`, `OPERATIONS_RUNBOOK`, `100K_SCALE_ARCHITECTURE`, `GROWTH_AUDIT`, `FIRST_100_CUSTOMERS`, `BREAK_EVEN_MODEL`, `SCALE_MODEL`, `PRODUCTION_ARCHITECTURE`.
